values: Use only the Budgets and Actuals sheets for import data. Keep each sheet’s column headers in row 1 and do not rename them.
Enter the fiscal year in the upload screen. FiscalYear is optional in the sheets. If entered, it must match the upload fiscal year.
Add one row per budget code and month. A code may appear in multiple months, but only once for the same month in this upload.
BudgetCode must already exist in the system. Month must be a month name or YYYY-MM. Amount must be a non-negative number.
Add one row for every actuals breakdown detail. Repeat ReleaseRef for all detail rows belonging to the same release.
Month is required for every detail. If ReleaseDate is entered, its month must match Month.
Use a stable reference for a release. A release can contain several detail rows. Do not reuse an existing reference for a new APPEND upload.
For a correction upload, use the existing ReleaseRef and include the complete corrected detail set for that release. Existing budget rows can be corrected by code and month.
APPEND adds new monthly budgets and releases. Existing code/month budget pairs and release references are rejected as duplicates.
REPLACE replaces AIE workbook data for the selected fiscal year. The system restricts this action to authorized roles and may require confirmation.
Some uploads enter pending review. The workbook is not reflected in data until an authorized reviewer approves it.
